remarks: welcome to Norwalk! The perfect blend of city convenience and suburban comfort. For Families relocating this area offers top-rated schools.  - Silvermine Elementary School, - West rocks Middle School, - Norwalk High School,   You'll love easy access to NYC - just a short train ride away- without the city traffic! Enjoy quiet neighborhoods, great dining, parks, and the coastal charm of Norwalk while still staying connected to everything you need.  Good credit and references a requisite.
